Metadata.title: Integris LaTeX
Metadata.description: Write, collaborate on and compile your LaTeX documents online: theses, articles, reports, courses, CVs. In French and English, with mobile money payments.

footer.tagline: An Integris Cloud service. Collaborative LaTeX editing, in French and English.

hero.eyebrow: From the first line to the final PDF
hero.title: Your ideas deserve <accent>a flawless document</accent>.
hero.lead: Write, collaborate on and compile your LaTeX documents online — theses, articles, reports, courses, CVs. Only your content should matter.
hero.note: Free to start · a phone number is all you need · in French and English

template.title: Template
template.text: Start from a ready-to-fill template, or import your project as a ZIP

writing.title: Writing
writing.text: Write together, in real time, in the same document

review.title: Review
review.text: Comments in the text and suggested corrections

versions.title: Versions
versions.text: Every version kept, restorable in one click

pdf.title: Final PDF
pdf.text: A clean PDF, ready to share or to have approved

features.title: Everything you need to write in LaTeX, nothing to install
features.intro: Students, researchers, teachers, freelancers or companies: a browser is all you need, on a computer or a phone.

editor.title: A complete LaTeX editor
editor.text: Syntax highlighting, autocompletion of commands, \ref and \cite, document outline, find and replace across the whole project.

compile.title: Compilation on our servers
compile.text: pdfLaTeX, XeLaTeX or LuaLaTeX with the full TeX Live. The first errors are translated and link to the right line.

realtime.title: Real-time collaboration
realtime.text: Invite co-authors by phone or email, with a role: editor, reviewer or viewer.

comments.title: Comments and suggestions
comments.text: Comment on a selection, reply, resolve. A suggested replacement is applied in one click.

history.title: Version history
history.text: An automatic version after each work session, named versions, and restore any of them.

mobile.title: On your phone too
mobile.text: Read the PDF, comment, compile and follow submissions from a phone, even on a modest connection.

supervision.title: Get your work reviewed and approved
supervision.intro: A thesis, a dissertation, an article or a report: send a frozen version, get feedback in the text and a clear approval.

share.title: Share with a role
share.text: Invite a supervisor who comments, suggests, sets deadlines and approves, or a reviewer and a viewer.

submit.title: Submit a frozen version
submit.text: Choose the files to review, add a message and a deadline. The version you sent no longer changes.

validate.title: Get approval
validate.text: Feedback, corrections, a new submission: once the supervisor approves, the submitted files are locked.

orgs.title: For teams, institutions and companies
orgs.text: With Team or Business, the owner pays for the seats and manages the members. Everyone keeps their own projects: paying never gives access to their content.
orgs.exams: Business: confidential exam papers sent to the secretariat

pricing.title: Start for free, pay when you need it
pricing.intro: Prices in FCFA, taxes included. Pay by mobile money via LigdiCash, PDF receipt sent by email, no automatic renewal charge. Every plan lets you submit a document to a supervisor.
pricing.unavailable: Pricing is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.

latex.question: I don't know LaTeX. Is this for me?
latex.answer: Yes. Start from a ready-to-fill template; the most common compilation errors are explained in French and English, with a link to the line concerned.

payment.question: How can I pay without a bank card?
payment.answer: By mobile money, via LigdiCash, directly on the platform. Your plan is activated as soon as the payment is confirmed and you receive a PDF receipt by email.

privacy.question: Is my work protected?
privacy.answer: Nobody can open a project without an invitation. Every compilation runs in an isolated environment. In a team or an institution, whoever pays sees usage, never the content of your projects.

import.question: Can I bring an existing project?
import.answer: Yes: import it as a ZIP, including an Overleaf export. The main file is main.tex by default and you can choose another one.

cta.title: Your next document can start today.
cta.text: A phone number is all you need to create your account.

summary.TEAM: For a small team, with one manager
summary.BUSINESS: For organisations: administrators, classes and programmes, supervision

brandAside.title: The academic writing platform of your institution.

institutions.title: Institutions
institutions.text: One subscription for the whole school: accounts, classes, official templates, exam printing.

teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.text: Follow your students, comment in the right place, write your exam papers and send them to the secretariat.

students.title: Students
students.text: Write dissertations, reports and theses that follow your institution's standards.

outside_project.title: Reading outside the project
outside_project.text: The document tries to read {file}, which is not part of the project. Only project files can be read during compilation.

shell_escape_refused.title: System command refused
shell_escape_refused.text: The command {command} was not run: compilation only allows TeX Live's safe commands (BibTeX, makeindex…). Packages such as minted are not supported.

system_command_refused.title: System command refused
system_command_refused.text: The Lua code tries to run a system command, which is not allowed during compilation.

lua_module_unavailable.title: Lua module unavailable
lua_module_unavailable.text: The Lua module {module} is not available during compilation (no network or system access).

write_refused.title: Writing outside the project
write_refused.text: The document tries to write {file} outside the project folder or to a hidden file. Only write ordinary files of the project.

cannot_write.title: Cannot write
cannot_write.text: The file {file} could not be written: the document probably produces too much data.

file_not_found.title: File not found
file_not_found.text: The file {file} is not in the project. Check its name and folder (case matters).

missing_file.title: File or package not found
missing_file.text: {file} cannot be found. If it is a project file, check its name; if it is a package, check its spelling.

environment_undefined.title: Unknown environment
environment_undefined.text: The environment {name} does not exist. Check its spelling or load the package that defines it.

begin_end_mismatch.title: Environment closed wrongly
begin_end_mismatch.text: \begin'{'{begin}'}' (line {beginLine}) is closed by \end'{'{end}'}'. Each \begin needs the \end of the same name.

missing_begin_document.title: Missing \begin'{'document'}'
missing_begin_document.text: Text appears before \begin'{'document'}', or this line is missing from the main file.

missing_item.title: Missing \item
missing_item.text: A list (itemize, enumerate…) contains text before its first \item.

lonely_item.title: \item outside a list
lonely_item.text: \item can only be used inside a list (itemize, enumerate, description).

option_clash.title: Option clash
option_clash.text: The package {package} is loaded twice with different options. Load it once with all its options.

unknown_option.title: Unknown option
unknown_option.text: The option {option} does not exist for the package {package}.

command_already_defined.title: Command already defined
command_already_defined.text: {command} already exists. Choose another name or use \renewcommand.

no_line_to_end.title: Misplaced line break
no_line_to_end.text: \\ is used where there is no line to end (start of a paragraph, empty line). Remove it or leave an empty line to start a new paragraph.

not_in_outer_par.title: Misplaced float
not_in_outer_par.text: A figure or table is placed where floats are not allowed (a box, a footnote, another float).

too_many_floats.title: Too many floats waiting
too_many_floats.text: Too many figures or tables are waiting to be placed. Add \clearpage or use the [htbp] option.

unknown_graphics_extension.title: Image format not supported
unknown_graphics_extension.text: The format {extension} is not accepted by this engine. Use PNG, JPG or PDF (EPS is converted automatically with pdfLaTeX).

graphic_size.title: Unknown image size
graphic_size.text: The size of an image could not be read. Check that the file is a real PNG, JPG or PDF image.

preamble_only.title: Preamble-only command
preamble_only.text: This command must come before \begin'{'document'}', like \usepackage.

unicode_not_set_up.title: Character not supported
unicode_not_set_up.text: The character {character} (U+{code}) is not available with pdfLaTeX. Use XeLaTeX or LuaLaTeX, or an equivalent LaTeX command.

invalid_utf8.title: Invalid encoding
invalid_utf8.text: A file contains characters that are not UTF-8. Save it as UTF-8.

missing_dollar_math.title: Badly delimited formula
missing_dollar_math.text: A mathematical formula is not opened or closed properly (\( \), \[ \] or $ $).

counter_too_large.title: Counter too large
counter_too_large.text: A counter goes beyond what its numbering can show (for example more than 26 with letters).

font_not_found.title: Font not found
font_not_found.text: The font {font} is not installed. Choose a TeX Live font or add its file to the project.

font_not_loadable.title: Font not found
font_not_loadable.text: The font {font} could not be loaded with this engine.

babel_language.title: Unknown language
babel_language.text: babel does not know the language {language}. Check its name (french, english…).

undefined_control_sequence.title: Unknown command
undefined_control_sequence.text: The command {command} does not exist. Check its spelling or load the package that defines it.

missing_dollar.title: Math mode missing
missing_dollar.text: A math symbol (^, _, \alpha…) is used outside a formula, or a formula is not closed. Surround it with $ … $.

too_many_braces.title: Extra closing brace
too_many_braces.text: A closing brace « '}' » closes something that was never opened.

extra_brace.title: Extra or forgotten brace
extra_brace.text: Braces are not balanced: one is missing or one is extra.

missing_brace.title: Unclosed brace
missing_brace.text: A brace « '{' » is never closed (or the other way round). The rest of the document may look wrong.

runaway_argument.title: Runaway argument
runaway_argument.text: The argument of a command never ends: a closing brace is probably missing.

file_ended.title: Unexpected end of file
file_ended.text: The file ends while reading {command}: a brace is not closed.

paragraph_ended.title: Paragraph ended
paragraph_ended.text: An empty line cuts the argument of {command}: a closing brace is probably missing.

math_delimiter.title: Math delimiter
math_delimiter.text: \left and \right must come in pairs, each followed by a delimiter (or a dot).

double_script.title: Double superscript or subscript
double_script.text: Two superscripts (^) or two subscripts (_) follow each other. Group them with braces, for example x^'{'ab'}'.

display_math.title: Display formula closed wrongly
display_math.text: A display formula is not closed properly. Use \[ … \] rather than $$ … $$.

invalid_character.title: Invalid character
invalid_character.text: The text read contains an invalid character (a control character). Check the file at this line.

misplaced_alignment.title: Misplaced «&»
misplaced_alignment.text: The «&» character separates table columns. Elsewhere, write \&.

extra_alignment_tab.title: Too many columns
extra_alignment_tab.text: A row of the table has more columns («&») than declared in tabular.

misplaced_noalign.title: Misplaced table command
misplaced_noalign.text: \{command} can only be used at the start of a table row (for example \hline right after \\).

illegal_parameter.title: Invalid parameter
illegal_parameter.text: A definition of {command} uses a # parameter that does not exist.

illegal_unit.title: Missing unit
illegal_unit.text: A length has no valid unit (cm, mm, pt, em…).

missing_number.title: Number expected
missing_number.text: A command expected a number or a length and found something else.

dimension_too_large.title: Dimension too large
dimension_too_large.text: A length goes beyond the largest size TeX handles (about 5.7 m).

missing_endcsname.title: Missing \endcsname
missing_endcsname.text: A command name built with \csname contains a forbidden character.

capacity_exceeded.title: TeX capacity exceeded
capacity_exceeded.text: TeX ran out of memory ({what}). Most often a macro calls itself endlessly.

emergency_stop.title: Compilation stopped
emergency_stop.text: TeX stopped after a serious error. Fix the previous error first.

undefined_reference.title: Reference not found
undefined_reference.text: The reference «{label}» does not exist yet. Check the matching \label.

undefined_citation.title: Citation not found
undefined_citation.text: The bibliography entry «{key}» is not in the project's .bib file.

multiply_defined_label.title: Duplicate label
multiply_defined_label.text: The label «{label}» is defined more than once. Each \label must be unique.

empty_bibliography.title: Bibliography to rebuild
empty_bibliography.text: Biber has not produced the bibliography yet. Compile again; if the message stays, check the .bib file.

no_pages.title: No page produced
no_pages.text: The document produces no page: there is no text between \begin'{'document'}' and \end'{'document'}'.

OutdatedBrowser.title: Outdated browser.
OutdatedBrowser.text: {product} may not work properly: the editor and the PDF preview need a recent browser. Install the latest version of <chrome>Google Chrome</chrome> or <firefox>Mozilla Firefox</firefox>.
